description: This file defines the vCard class, which manages the creation, manipulation, import, and export of vCard data within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for setting contact properties, importing vCards from files, and generating vCard string representations.

classes.name: vCard
classes.description: Represents a vCard with methods to load, modify, and export contact information, as well as import vCards from files.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets all properties of the vCard object.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Loads contact data from the database into the vCard object based on contact ID.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the TITLE property of the vCard.

methods.name: setORG
methods.description: Sets the ORG property with organization name and department.

methods.name: setAddress
methods.description: Sets the ADR property with address details.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name fields (N and FN) of the vCard.

methods.name: setPhoneNumber
methods.description: Sets a TEL property with a specific phone number and type.

methods.name: setBirthDate
methods.description: Sets the BDAY property representing the contact's birth date.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value by name.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value by name.

methods.name: saveVCard
methods.description: Outputs the vCard as a downloadable file or inline content.

methods.name: importVCard
methods.description: Imports contact data from a vCard file into a contact object.
